Class GTCompat

java.lang.Object
io.github.wurtzitane.avogadro.compat.gt.GTCompat
public final class GTCompat extends Object
Optional adapter for GregTechCEu 1.12.2 2.8.10-beta (release tag v2.8.10), source commit 9fe140febe8747bbe2f06dfd570421331ec06f4b. No GregTech classes are linked when the standalone library is loaded, including on a dedicated server.
